name: BackgroundWorker
label: Queue Workers
description: Background worker processes connected to the task queue — a live snapshot from Redis, nothing is stored in the DB. A running worker checks the queue every few seconds; one silent for over 10 minutes has most likely crashed or restarted under a new name, and can be deleted.

fields.label: Worker
fields.description: Consumer name the worker process registered with in the queue.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Busy — running tasks right now; Idle — alive and waiting for tasks; Dead — has not checked the queue for over 10 minutes.

fields.label: Running tasks
fields.description: Tasks this worker has taken and not finished yet. On a dead worker these tasks are stuck until a live worker picks them up.

fields.label: Last seen
fields.description: When the worker last checked the queue.

fields.label: Last task finished
fields.description: When the worker last completed a task. Empty — it has not completed any yet.
